proxy.title: Local Proxy
proxy.autoStartDesc:
Starts the proxy when the app launches; if the port is taken it slides to the next free port, and stops when the app exits.
Clicking "Start" checks and remembers this option — it will auto-start next time.
proxy.usage1: 1. After starting the proxy, set baseURL in the DevEco Code config file to:
proxy.usage2: 2. The proxy forwards requests to the active Provider and records cost & latency.
proxy.usage3: 3. With "Auto Failover" on, when the current provider fails it switches to the next one in the failover queue.
